doc.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

title: Handbill for 'Rose of Spain' and 'You're the Only Girl'
summary: A handbill advertising two hit songs, probably a sheet music cover.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Look. Let's see. Now here's another. Looks like a handbill advertising for these tunes. It says, quote, two new hits, please. Hit number one, Rose of Spain. Whoa. Rose of Spain. Rose of Spain. A breezy summer dance and song success now being featured in the stupendous Edwin Carnival.

A rare blossom from the garden of hits. Hit number two. Fred Fisher's sensation. You're the only girl that made me cry. No wonder they, quote, cry, unquote, for more. Try it and you'll, quote, cry, unquote, yet.
That's pretty. A nice thing to have.
I'll give you that, but I think that's the only one that I can find was. He has a grip just packed and stuff.
That might have been a cover of the sheet music or something.
A cover of the sheet music.
